conversation_summary: Rewrote the hq-integrations skill for the full CLI lifecycle and opened indigoai-us/hq-core-staging#574; completes the three-PR chain with hq-pro#2212 and hq-cli#397
next_steps: Merge/ship order is a hard chain: hq-pro#2212 merge AND deploy → hq-cli#397 merge AND npm publish → hq-core-staging#574 promote. Promoting the skill early documents commands the installed CLI lacks; requested in the PR body that promotion be held.
Verify CI on hq-core-staging#574 (was still running at turn end; background task bs4l62zb5)
After promotion lands in hq-core, run /update-hq on this install so the local .claude/skills/hq-integrations/SKILL.md picks up the rewrite
learnings: Before editing any .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, check whether it is a real core file or a personal/ symlink: a real file is release-owned and must be changed in repos/private/hq-core-staging with a PR to hq-core-staging, never hand-edited locally and never PR'd to hq-core.
The .agents/skills/<name>/ mirror is a generated, git-untracked view of .claude/skills/<name>/ — editing the .claude copy updates it automatically; do not edit or commit the .agents path.

hq-core-staging ships skill validators runnable without CI: core/scripts/tests/{skill-command-refs,skill-script-refs,export-skill-catalog,agent-runtime-skill-metadata}.test.sh — run these locally after any SKILL.md edit.
decisions: Edited the skill in repos/private/hq-core-staging via worktree and PR'd to hq-core-staging rather than hand-editing local .claude/skills/ — release-owned scaffold is wiped by /update-hq, and hq-core-prs-go-to-staging-not-hq-core forbids PRs against hq-core; local install stays stale until promotion + /update-hq, which is the intended flow

Dropped the skill's hardcoded 'requires hq-cli >= 5.62' in favour of 'unknown command means update the CLI' rather than asserting an unreleased version number — hq-cli versions are stamped at release time, so any number written now would be a guess

Skill explicitly documents the two distinct OAuth connect outcomes (Connected = live vs printed sign-in URL = NOT connected yet) because misreporting the console-handoff path as success is the most likely agent failure mode
